lead_raw_text:
The structure of LuZrGe₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4₂/mnm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing eight atoms across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ge centers in tetrahedral environments with four geometric neighbors (three Ge, one Lu; one Ge orbit, four unit-cell atoms), while Lu and Zr each have 16 neighbors (eight Ge and eight Zr/Lu, respectively). The Ge tetrahedra share corners with one another, and corner- and edge-sharing is observed between Ge tetrahedra and the Lu and Zr 16-vertex coordination polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites.
